[34] Chuyu Wang, Lei Xie, Yuancan Lin, Wei Wang, and Yingying Chen et al. 2021. Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID
by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration. Proc. ACM Interact. Mob. Wearable Ubiquitous Technol.5, 4 (2021), 182:1–182:25.
paper_level_summary_zh: 引用论文在实验设置中提到使用开源项目[23]（USRP Reader）来捕获谐波RF信号，但[23]是一个软件/硬件项目，并非目标论文。因此，该引用属于技术实现参考，并非对目标论文方法或能力的陈述。

evidences.evidence_quote: We implement RF-Mic using an Impinj Speedway R420 COTS RFID reader to transmit RF signals and a USRP N210 with a SBX daughter-board according to the open source project [23] for capturing the harmonic RF signals.
evidences.evidence_context: We implement RF-Mic using an Impinj Speedway R420 COTS RFID reader to transmit RF signals and a USRP N210 with a SBX daughter-board according to the open source project [23] for capturing the harmonic RF signals.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用[23]是一个开源软件项目（USRP Reader的GitHub仓库），并非目标论文。目标论文是Wang等人的Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping...论文。因此这是典型的误引用。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
